rows.text: • The Company updated its fiscal 2027 outlook, with net sales now expected to decrease 1.0 to 2.0 percent, adjusted earnings per share to range from $10.50 to $11.00, and free cash flow of approximately $1.1 billion.

The adjusted earnings per share range now includes a net benefit of approximately $0.60 related to the receipt of tariff refunds, which reflects the $0.84 benefit from tariff refunds received in the first quarter, net of planned investments in SD&A expenses.
